summary: Neo hangs up the phone inside the booth and steps out, sliding Neo removes his sunglasses and puts them on. He gazes upward. the camera rises upward and upward, with the city far beneath. Neo then blasts past, flying faster than a speeding bullet with his tattered black cloak streaming behind him like a dark leather banner. The scene fades out and ends.
